subject: Patch andesim QEMU: ax46mpv must advertise MMSC_CFG.VDOT
description: Not needed. Verified live: a freestanding probe with nds.vd4dots.vv runs correctly under `andesim run --mode fast --engine vsim:ax46mpv_fpga_l3` (prints the right lane sums). The engine's -readconfig qemu cfg enables MMSC_CFG.VDOT even though cpu.c's andes-ax46mpv default omits it.
activeForm: Patching andesim QEMU ax46mpv VDOT bit
